target: Original source R6; precise legacy/executor version not supplied
executorRequired: HTTP GET through request/http_request/syn.request or game:HttpGet
getobjects or game:GetObjects capable of local .rbxmx deserialization
dataBackend: Typed JSON: create Instances, assign properties, link parents and resolve references. Original costume CSG uses sanitized full .rbxmx local-file deserialization.
knownLimits: No Roblox engine, executor session or old client was available.
Original hosted mesh/texture/sound/animation permissions were not tested.
Local .rbxmx deserialization support varies by executor; capability failures stop bootstrap with a named error.
MeshPart JSON fallback uses original MeshId/TextureID through SpecialMesh; SurfaceAppearance/PBR is not represented by that fallback.
Unavailable optional cosmetic classes/properties are reported and may change borders or lighting on old clients.
The old animation player is reproduced at nominal 60 Hz using its per-keyframe source timing; frame-rate-dependent bugs are not certified.
Adonis and Kohl's Admin hosted modules are absent from the source and are preserved for separate integration, not activated in the server.
